speaker: naomi
name: Naomi
text: Go back, each of you to your mother’s home. May the LORD show you loving devotion, as you have shown to your dead and to me.

speaker: naomi
text: May the LORD enable each of you to find rest in the home of your new husband.

speaker: ruth-and-orpah
name: Ruth and Orpah
text: Surely we will return with you to your people.

speaker: naomi
text: Return home, my daughters. Why would you go with me? Are there still sons in my womb to become your husbands?

speaker: naomi
text: Return home, my daughters. Go on, for I am too old to have another husband. Even if I thought there was hope for me to have a husband tonight and to bear sons,

speaker: naomi
text: would you wait for them to grow up? Would you refrain from having husbands? No, my daughters, it grieves me very much for your sakes that the hand of the LORD has gone out against me.

speaker: naomi
text: Look,

speaker: naomi
text: your sister-in-law has gone back to her people and her gods; follow her back home.

speaker: ruth
name: Ruth
text: Do not urge me to leave you or to turn from following you. For wherever you go, I will go, and wherever you live, I will live; your people will be my people, and your God will be my God.

speaker: ruth
text: Where you die, I will die, and there I will be buried. May the LORD punish me, and ever so severely, if anything but death separates you and me.

speaker: women-of-bethlehem
name: The women of Bethlehem
text: Can this be Naomi?

speaker: naomi
text: Do not call me Naomi,

speaker: naomi
text: Call me Mara, because the Almighty has dealt quite bitterly with me.

speaker: naomi
text: I went away full, but the LORD has brought me back empty. Why call me Naomi? After all, the LORD has testified against me, and the Almighty has afflicted me.

speaker: ruth
name: Ruth
text: Please let me go into the fields and glean heads of grain after someone in whose sight I may find favor.

speaker: naomi
name: Naomi
text: Go ahead, my daughter,

speaker: boaz
name: Boaz
text: The LORD be with you.

speaker: harvesters-of-boaz
name: The harvesters of Boaz
text: The LORD bless you,

speaker: boaz
text: Whose young woman is this?

speaker: unnamed-foreman-of-boaz
name: The foreman of Boaz’s harvesters
text: She is the Moabitess who returned with Naomi from the land of Moab.

speaker: unnamed-foreman-of-boaz
text: She has said, ‘Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves after the harvesters.’ So she came out and has continued from morning until now, except that she rested a short time in the shelter.

speaker: ruth
text: Please let me glean and gather among the sheaves after the harvesters.

speaker: boaz
text: Listen, my daughter. Do not go and glean in another field, and do not go away from this place, but stay here close to my servant girls.

speaker: boaz
text: Let your eyes be on the field they are harvesting, and follow along after these girls. Indeed, I have ordered the young men not to touch you. And when you are thirsty, go and drink from the jars the young men have filled.

speaker: ruth
text: Why have I found such favor in your eyes that you should take notice of me, even though I am a foreigner?

speaker: boaz
text: I have been made fully aware of all you have done for your mother-in-law since the death of your husband, how you left your father and mother and the land of your birth, and how you came to a people you did not know before.

speaker: boaz
text: May the LORD repay your work, and may you receive a rich reward from the LORD, the God of Israel, under whose wings you have taken refuge.

speaker: ruth
text: My lord,

speaker: ruth
text: may I continue to find favor in your eyes, for you have comforted and spoken kindly to your maidservant, though I am not like one of your servant girls.

speaker: boaz
text: Come over here; have some bread and dip it into the vinegar sauce.

speaker: boaz
text: Even if she gathers among the sheaves, do not insult her.

speaker: boaz
text: Rather, pull out for her some stalks from the bundles and leave them for her to gather. Do not rebuke her.

speaker: naomi
text: Where did you glean today, and where did you work? Blessed be the man who noticed you.

speaker: ruth
text: The name of the man I worked with today is Boaz,

speaker: naomi
text: May he be blessed by the LORD, who has not withdrawn His kindness from the living or the dead.

speaker: naomi
text: The man is a close relative. He is one of our kinsman-redeemers.

speaker: ruth
text: He also told me, ‘Stay with my young men until they have finished gathering all my harvest.’

speaker: boaz
text: Stay with my young men until they have finished gathering all my harvest.

speaker: naomi
text: My daughter, it is good for you to work with his young women, so that nothing will happen to you in another field.

speaker: naomi
name: Naomi
text: My daughter, should I not seek a resting place for you, that it may be well with you?

speaker: naomi
text: Now is not Boaz, with whose servant girls you have been working, a relative of ours? In fact, tonight he is winnowing barley on the threshing floor.

speaker: naomi
text: Therefore wash yourself, put on perfume, and wear your best clothes. Go down to the threshing floor, but do not let the man know you are there until he has finished eating and drinking.

speaker: naomi
text: When he lies down, note the place where he lies. Then go in and uncover his feet, and lie down, and he will explain to you what you should do.

speaker: ruth
name: Ruth
text: I will do everything you say,

speaker: boaz
name: Boaz
text: Who are you?

speaker: ruth
text: I am your servant Ruth,

speaker: ruth
text: Spread the corner of your garment over me, for you are a kinsman-redeemer.

speaker: boaz
text: May the LORD bless you, my daughter. You have shown more kindness now than before, because you have not run after the younger men, whether rich or poor.

speaker: boaz
text: And now do not be afraid, my daughter. I will do for you whatever you request, since all my fellow townspeople know that you are a woman of noble character.

speaker: boaz
text: Yes, it is true that I am a kinsman-redeemer, but there is a redeemer nearer than I.

speaker: boaz
text: Stay here tonight, and in the morning, if he wants to redeem you, good. Let him redeem you. But if he does not want to redeem you, as surely as the LORD lives, I will. Now lie here until morning.

speaker: boaz
text: Do not let it be known that a woman came to the threshing floor.

speaker: boaz
text: Bring the shawl you are wearing and hold it out.

speaker: naomi
text: How did it go, my daughter?

speaker: ruth
text: He gave me these six measures of barley, for he said, ‘Do not go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed.’

speaker: boaz
text: Do not go back to your mother-in-law empty-handed.

speaker: naomi
text: Wait, my daughter,

speaker: naomi
text: until you find out how things go, for he will not rest unless he has resolved the matter today.

speaker: boaz
name: Boaz
text: Come over here, my friend, and sit down.

speaker: boaz
text: Sit here,

speaker: boaz
text: Naomi, who has returned from the land of Moab, is selling the piece of land that belonged to our brother Elimelech.

speaker: boaz
text: I thought I should inform you that you may buy it back in the presence of those seated here and in the presence of the elders of my people. If you want to redeem it, do so. But if you will not redeem it, tell me so I may know, because there is no one but you to redeem it, and I am next after you.

speaker: unnamed-kinsman-redeemer
name: Unnamed kinsman-redeemer
text: I will redeem it,

speaker: boaz
text: On the day you buy the land from Naomi and also from Ruth the Moabitess, you must also acquire the widow of the deceased in order to raise up the name of the deceased on his inheritance.

speaker: unnamed-kinsman-redeemer
text: I cannot redeem it myself, or I would jeopardize my own inheritance. Take my right of redemption, because I cannot redeem it.

speaker: unnamed-kinsman-redeemer
text: Buy it for yourself.

speaker: boaz
text: You are witnesses today that I am buying from Naomi all that belonged to Elimelech, Chilion, and Mahlon.

speaker: boaz
text: Moreover, I have acquired Ruth the Moabitess, Mahlon’s widow, as my wife, to raise up the name of the deceased through his inheritance, so that his name will not disappear from among his brothers or from the gate of his home. You are witnesses today.

speaker: elders-and-people-of-bethlehem
name: The elders and all the people at the gate
text: We are witnesses,
tag: the elders and all the people at the gate

speaker: elders-and-people-of-bethlehem
text: May the LORD make the woman entering your home like Rachel and Leah, who together built up the house of Israel. May you be prosperous in Ephrathah and famous in Bethlehem.
tag: the elders and all the people at the gate

speaker: elders-and-people-of-bethlehem
text: And may your house become like the house of Perez, whom Tamar bore to Judah, because of the offspring the LORD will give you by this young woman.

speaker: women-of-bethlehem
name: The women of Bethlehem
text: Blessed be the LORD, who has not left you this day without a kinsman-redeemer. May his name become famous in Israel.

speaker: women-of-bethlehem
text: He will renew your life and sustain you in your old age. For your daughter-in-law, who loves you and is better to you than seven sons, has given him birth.

speaker: women-of-bethlehem
text: A son has been born to Naomi,
